sentences.zh: 既而亦為西夏所攻走，至龜茲國，龜茲國主以兵討殺之。

translations.literal: Before long he was again attacked and driven off by the Western Xia; he reached the kingdom of Kucha, and the king of Kucha sent troops to pursue and kill him.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the Western Xia attacked and drove him off again. He reached the kingdom of Kucha, and the king of Kucha sent troops to pursue and kill him.

sentences.zh: 帝既滅汪罕，大獵於帖麥該川，宣佈號令，振凱而歸。

translations.literal: The Emperor, having destroyed Ong Khan, held a great hunt on the Temechi River, proclaimed his commands, and returned in triumph.
translations.idiomatic: After destroying Ong Khan, the Emperor held a great hunt on the Temechi River, proclaimed his commands, and returned in triumph.

sentences.zh: 時乃蠻部長太陽罕心忌帝能，遣使謀於白達達部主阿剌忽思曰：「吾聞東方有稱帝者，天無二日，民豈有二王耶？

translations.literal: At that time Taiyang Khan, chieftain of the Naiman tribe, envied the Emperor's ability in his heart and sent envoys to plot with Alaqush, chieftain of the White Tartar tribe, saying: "I hear that in the east there is one who calls himself emperor. Heaven has no two suns — can the people have two kings?
translations.idiomatic: At that time Taiyang Khan, chieftain of the Naiman, envied the Emperor's ability and sent envoys to plot with Alaqush, chieftain of the White Tartars, saying, "I hear that in the east there is one who calls himself emperor. Heaven has no two suns—can the people have two kings?

sentences.zh: 君能益吾右翼，吾將奪其弧矢也。

translations.literal: If you will strengthen my right wing, I shall seize his bow and arrows.
translations.idiomatic: If you will strengthen my right wing, I shall seize his bow and arrows.

sentences.zh: 」阿剌忽思即以是謀報帝，居無何，舉部來歸。

translations.literal: " Alaqush at once reported this plot to the Emperor; before long he came over with his whole tribe in submission.
translations.idiomatic: " Alaqush at once reported this plot to the Emperor. Before long he came over with his whole tribe in submission.

sentences.zh: 歲甲子，帝大會於帖麥該川，議伐乃蠻。

translations.literal: In the jiazi year the Emperor held a great assembly on the Temechi River and deliberated attacking the Naiman.
translations.idiomatic: In the jiazi year the Emperor held a great assembly on the Temechi River and deliberated attacking the Naiman.

sentences.zh: 群臣以方春馬瘦，宜俟秋高為言。

translations.literal: The ministers said that it was spring and the horses were lean, and that they should wait until autumn when the grass was high.
translations.idiomatic: The ministers said it was spring and the horses were lean, and that they should wait until autumn when the grass stood high.

sentences.zh: 皇弟斡赤斤曰：「事所當為，斷之在早，何可以馬瘦為辭？

translations.literal: The Emperor's younger brother Otchigin said: "What ought to be done must be decided early — how can lean horses serve as an excuse?
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor's younger brother Otchigin said, "What ought to be done must be decided early—how can lean horses serve as an excuse?

sentences.zh: 」別裏古台亦曰：「乃蠻欲奪我弧矢，是小我也，我輩義當同死。

translations.literal: " Belgutei also said: "The Naiman wish to seize our bow and arrows — that is to make little of us; we in duty should die together.
translations.idiomatic: " Belgutei also said, "The Naiman wish to seize our bow and arrows—that is to make little of us. We in duty should die together.

sentences.zh: 彼恃其國大而言誇，苟乘其不備而攻之，功當可成也。

translations.literal: They rely on the size of their state and speak boastfully; if we attack them while they are unprepared, the achievement should be attainable.
translations.idiomatic: They rely on the size of their state and speak boastfully. If we attack while they are unprepared, success should be within reach.

sentences.zh: 」帝悅，曰：「以此眾戰，何憂不勝。

translations.literal: " The Emperor was pleased and said: "With this host to fight, why worry that we shall not win?
translations.idiomatic: " The Emperor was pleased and said, "With this host to fight, why worry that we shall not win?

sentences.zh: 」遂進兵伐乃蠻，駐兵於建忒該山，先遣虎必來、哲別二人為前鋒。

translations.literal: " He then advanced to attack the Naiman, encamped on Mount Jété Qai, and first sent Hubilai and Jebe — two men — as vanguard.
translations.idiomatic: " He then advanced to attack the Naiman, encamped on Mount Jété Qai, and first sent Hubilai and Jebe as vanguard.

sentences.zh: 太陽罕至自按台，營於沆海山，與蔑裏乞部長脫脫、克烈部長阿憐太石、猥剌部長忽都花別吉，暨禿魯班、塔塔兒、哈答斤、散只兀諸部合，兵勢頗盛。

translations.literal: Taiyang Khan came from Altai and encamped on Mount Khanqai, joining with Toqto'a, chieftain of the Merkit tribe, Alin Taishi, chieftain of the Kerait tribe, Qutuqa Beki, chieftain of the Oirat tribe, and the Dorben, Tatar, Qadaghin, and Saji'ut tribes — his military strength was quite formidable.
translations.idiomatic: Taiyang Khan came from Altai and encamped on Mount Khanqai, joining with Toqto'a of the Merkit, Alin Taishi of the Kerait, Qutuqa Beki of the Oirat, and the Dorben, Tatar, Qadaghin, and Saji'ut tribes. His military strength was quite formidable.

sentences.zh: 時我隊中羸馬有驚入乃蠻營中者，太陽罕見之，與眾謀曰：「蒙古之馬瘦弱如此，今當誘其深入，然後戰而擒之。

translations.literal: At that time a lean horse in our ranks, startled, ran into the Naiman camp; Taiyang Khan saw it and deliberated with the host, saying: "The Mongol horses are lean to this degree — we should now lure them deep in, then fight and capture them.
translations.idiomatic: At that time a lean horse in our ranks, startled, ran into the Naiman camp. Taiyang Khan saw it and deliberated with the host, saying, "The Mongol horses are lean to this degree—we should lure them deep in, then fight and capture them.

sentences.zh: 」其將火力速八赤對曰：「先王戰伐，勇進不回，馬尾人背不使敵人見之。

translations.literal: " His general Qo'udun replied: "Former kings in battle and campaign advanced bravely and did not turn back; they did not let the enemy see their horses' tails or men's backs.
translations.idiomatic: " His general Qo'udun replied, "Former kings in battle advanced bravely and did not turn back; they did not let the enemy see their horses' tails or men's backs.

sentences.zh: 今為此遷延之計，得非心中有所懼乎？

translations.literal: Now you adopt this delaying plan — could it be that there is fear in your heart?
translations.idiomatic: Now you adopt this delaying plan—could it be that there is fear in your heart?

sentences.zh: 苟懼之，何不令后妃來統軍也。

translations.literal: If you fear, why not let the queens and consorts come to command the army?
translations.idiomatic: If you fear, why not let the queens and consorts come to command the army?

sentences.zh: 」太陽罕怒，即躍馬索戰。

translations.literal: " Taiyang Khan grew angry and at once leaped on his horse to demand battle.
translations.idiomatic: " Taiyang Khan grew angry and at once leaped on his horse to demand battle.

sentences.zh: 帝以哈撒兒主中軍。

translations.literal: The Emperor put Khasar in command of the center army.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor put Khasar in command of the center army.

sentences.zh: 時劄木合從太陽罕來，見帝軍容整肅，謂左右曰：「乃蠻初舉兵，視蒙古軍若甗珝羔兒，意謂蹄皮亦不留。

translations.literal: At that time Jamuqa had come with Taiyang Khan; seeing the Emperor's army arrayed in good order, he said to those at his side: "When the Naiman first raised troops, they looked on the Mongol army as though it were a cauldron of lamb — they meant not to leave even hoof or hide.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Jamuqa had come with Taiyang Khan. Seeing the Emperor's army arrayed in good order, he said to those at his side, "When the Naiman first raised troops, they looked on the Mongol army as a cauldron of lamb—they meant not to leave even hoof or hide.

sentences.zh: 今吾觀其氣勢，殆非往時矣。

translations.literal: Now, watching their bearing and force, they are surely not as in former times.
translations.idiomatic: Now, watching their bearing and force, they are surely not as in former times.

sentences.zh: 」遂引所部兵遁去。

translations.literal: " He then led his own troops and slipped away.
translations.idiomatic: " He then led his own troops and slipped away.

sentences.zh: 是日，帝與乃蠻軍大戰至晡，禽殺太陽罕。

translations.literal: That day the Emperor fought a great battle with the Naiman army until evening and captured and killed Taiyang Khan.
translations.idiomatic: That day the Emperor fought a great battle with the Naiman army until evening and captured and killed Taiyang Khan.

sentences.zh: 諸部軍一時皆潰，夜走絕險，墜崖死者不可勝計。

translations.literal: The armies of the various tribes at once all broke and fled; by night they ran through perilous passes, and those who fell from cliffs and died could not be counted.
translations.idiomatic: The armies of the various tribes at once broke and fled. By night they ran through perilous passes, and those who fell from cliffs and died could not be counted.

sentences.zh: 明日，餘眾悉降。

translations.literal: The next day the remaining host all surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: The next day the remaining host all surrendered.

sentences.zh: 於是朵魯班、塔塔兒、哈答斤、散只兀四部亦來降。

translations.literal: Thereupon the Dorben, Tatar, Qadaghin, and Saji'ut — four tribes — also came to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon the Dorben, Tatar, Qadaghin, and Saji'ut—four tribes—also came to surrender.

sentences.zh: 已而復征蔑裏乞部，其長脫脫奔太陽罕之兄卜欲魯罕，其屬帶兒兀孫獻女迎降，俄復叛去。

translations.literal: Before long he again campaigned against the Merkit tribe; their chieftain Toqto'a fled to Buyiru Khan, elder brother of Taiyang Khan, while his follower Ta'ir Usun offered his daughter in submission, then soon rebelled and went away.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he again campaigned against the Merkit. Their chieftain Toqto'a fled to Buyiru Khan, elder brother of Taiyang Khan, while his follower Ta'ir Usun offered his daughter in submission, then soon rebelled and went away.

sentences.zh: 帝至泰寒寨，遣孛羅歡、沈白二人領右軍往平之。"

translations.literal: The Emperor reached the Taihan camp and sent Boroqul and Shenbai — two men — to lead the right army to pacify them.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor reached the Taihan camp and sent Boroqul and Shenbai to lead the right army to pacify them.

sentences.zh: 歲乙丑，帝征西夏，拔力吉裏寨，經落思城，大掠人民及其橐駝而還。

translations.literal: In the yichou year the Emperor campaigned against the Western Xia, took the Lijili camp, passed through Luosi city, and returned after greatly plundering the people and their baggage camels.
translations.idiomatic: In the yichou year the Emperor campaigned against the Western Xia, took the Lijili camp, passed through Luosi city, and returned after greatly plundering the people and their baggage camels.

sentences.zh: 二年丁卯秋，再征西夏，克斡羅孩城。

translations.literal: In the second year, dingmao, in autumn he again campaigned against the Western Xia and took Wulohai city.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, dingmao, in autumn he again campaigned against the Western Xia and took Wulohai city.

sentences.zh: 是歲，遣按彈、不兀剌二人使乞力吉思。

translations.literal: That year he sent Altan and Buqa — two men — as envoys to the Kyrgyz.
translations.idiomatic: That year he sent Altan and Buqa as envoys to the Kyrgyz.

sentences.zh: 既而野牒亦納裏部、阿裏替也兒部，皆通使來獻名鷹。

translations.literal: Before long the Yenisei Kirghiz tribe and the Altayir tribe also sent envoys bearing tribute of famous hawks.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the Yenisei Kirghiz tribe and the Altayir tribe also sent envoys bearing tribute of famous hawks.

sentences.zh: 三年戊辰春，帝至自西夏。

translations.literal: In the third year, wuchen, in spring the Emperor returned from the Western Xia campaign.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, wuchen, in spring the Emperor returned from the Western Xia campaign.

sentences.zh: 夏，避暑龍庭。

translations.literal: In summer he summered at the Dragon Court.
translations.idiomatic: In summer he summered at the Dragon Court.

sentences.zh: 冬，再征脫脫及屈出律罕。

translations.literal: In winter he again campaigned against Toqto'a and Küchlüg Khan.
translations.idiomatic: In winter he again campaigned against Toqto'a and Küchlüg Khan.

sentences.zh: 時斡亦剌部等遇我前鋒，不戰而降，因用為嚮導。

translations.literal: At that time the Oirat tribe and others met our vanguard and surrendered without fighting; they were therefore used as guides.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the Oirat tribe and others met our vanguard and surrendered without fighting; they were therefore used as guides.

sentences.zh: 至也兒的石河，討蔑裏乞部，滅之，脫脫中流矢死，屈出律奔契丹。

translations.literal: When he reached the Irtysh River he attacked the Merkit tribe and destroyed them; Toqto'a died from an arrow wound in midstream, and Küchlüg fled to the Khitan.
translations.idiomatic: When he reached the Irtysh River he attacked the Merkit and destroyed them. Toqto'a died from an arrow wound in midstream, and Küchlüg fled to the Khitan.

sentences.zh: 四年己巳春，畏吾兒國來歸。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, jisi, in spring the Uighur state came over in submission.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, jisi, in spring the Uighur state came over in submission.

sentences.zh: 帝入河西，夏主李安全遣其世子率師來戰，敗之，獲其副元帥高令公。

translations.literal: The Emperor entered Hexi; the Western Xia ruler Li Anquan sent his heir at the head of troops to give battle — the Emperor defeated them and captured their deputy commander Gao Linggong.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor entered Hexi. The Western Xia ruler Li Anquan sent his heir at the head of troops to give battle; the Emperor defeated them and captured their deputy commander Gao Linggong.

sentences.zh: 克兀剌海城，俘其太傅西壁氏。

translations.literal: He took Wulahai city and captured its Grand Tutor of the Xibi clan.
translations.idiomatic: He took Wulahai city and captured its Grand Tutor of the Xibi clan.

sentences.zh: 進至克夷門，復敗夏師，獲其將嵬名令公。

translations.literal: Advancing to Keyimen, he again defeated the Western Xia army and captured their general Weiming Linggong.
translations.idiomatic: Advancing to Keyimen, he again defeated the Western Xia army and captured their general Weiming Linggong.

sentences.zh: 薄中興府，引河水灌之，堤決，水外潰，遂撤圍還。

translations.literal: Pressing Zhongxing Prefecture, he diverted the river to flood it; the dike broke and the water burst outward, so he withdrew the siege and returned.
translations.idiomatic: Pressing Zhongxing Prefecture, he diverted the river to flood it. The dike broke and the water burst outward, so he withdrew the siege and returned.

sentences.zh: 遣太傅訛答入中興，招諭夏主，夏主納女請和。

translations.literal: He sent Grand Tutor Yoda into Zhongxing to summon and instruct the Western Xia ruler; the Western Xia ruler offered a daughter and sued for peace.
translations.idiomatic: He sent Grand Tutor Yoda into Zhongxing to summon and instruct the Western Xia ruler. The Western Xia ruler offered a daughter and sued for peace.

sentences.zh: 五年庚午春，金謀來伐，築烏沙堡。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, gengwu, in spring the Jin plotted to come and attack and built Wusha Fort.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, gengwu, in spring the Jin plotted to come and attack and built Wusha Fort.

sentences.zh: 帝命遮別襲殺其眾，遂略地而東。

translations.literal: The Emperor ordered Jebe to raid and kill their host, then carried out a campaign eastward.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor ordered Jebe to raid and kill their host, then carried out a campaign eastward.

sentences.zh: 初，帝貢歲幣於金，金主使衛王允濟受貢於淨州。

translations.literal: Earlier the Emperor had paid annual tribute to the Jin; the Jin ruler had the Prince of Wei, Yongji, receive tribute at Jing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier the Emperor had paid annual tribute to the Jin. The Jin ruler had the Prince of Wei, Yongji, receive tribute at Jing Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 帝見允濟不為禮。

translations.literal: The Emperor saw that Yongji did not observe the rites.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor saw that Yongji did not observe the rites.

sentences.zh: 允濟歸，欲請兵攻之。

translations.literal: When Yongji returned, he wished to request troops to attack him.
translations.idiomatic: When Yongji returned, he wished to request troops to attack him.

sentences.zh: 會金主璟殂，允濟嗣位，有詔至國，傳言當拜受。

translations.literal: It happened that the Jin ruler Jing died and Yongji succeeded to the throne; an imperial decree arrived in the state, and word passed that he should bow to receive it.
translations.idiomatic: It happened that the Jin ruler Jing died and Yongji succeeded to the throne. An imperial decree arrived in the state, and word passed that he should bow to receive it.

sentences.zh: 帝問金使曰：「新君為誰？

translations.literal: The Emperor asked the Jin envoy: "Who is the new ruler?
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor asked the Jin envoy, "Who is the new ruler?

sentences.zh: 」金使曰：「衛王也。

translations.literal: " The Jin envoy said: "The Prince of Wei.
translations.idiomatic: " The Jin envoy said, "The Prince of Wei.

sentences.zh: 」帝遽南面唾曰：「我謂中原皇帝是天上人做，此等庸懦亦為之耶？

translations.literal: " The Emperor at once turned south and spat, saying: "I thought the Central Plains emperor was made by Heaven — can such a mediocre coward also be one?
translations.idiomatic: " The Emperor at once turned south and spat, saying, "I thought the Central Plains emperor was made by Heaven—can such a mediocre coward also be one?

sentences.zh: 何以拜為！

translations.literal: Why should I bow to him!
translations.idiomatic: Why should I bow to him!

sentences.zh: 」即乘馬北去。

translations.literal: " He immediately mounted his horse and went north.
translations.idiomatic: " He immediately mounted his horse and went north.

sentences.zh: 金使還言，允濟益怒，欲俟帝再入貢，就進場害之。

translations.literal: When the Jin envoy returned and reported, Yongji grew still angrier and wished to wait until the Emperor came again to pay tribute, then seize the occasion in the reception hall to harm him.
translations.idiomatic: When the Jin envoy returned and reported, Yongji grew still angrier and wished to wait until the Emperor came again to pay tribute, then seize the occasion in the reception hall to harm him.

sentences.zh: 帝知之，遂與金絕，益嚴兵為備。

translations.literal: The Emperor learned of it, broke off relations with the Jin, and tightened his military preparations still further.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor learned of it, broke off relations with the Jin, and tightened his military preparations still further.

sentences.zh: 六年辛未春，帝居怯綠連河。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, xinwei, in spring the Emperor resided on the Kereulen River.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, xinwei, in spring the Emperor resided on the Kereulen River.

sentences.zh: 西域哈剌魯部主阿昔蘭罕來降，畏吾兒國主亦都護來覲。

translations.literal: Ala Qush, chieftain of the Qarluq tribe of the Western Regions, came over in submission; the Uighur ruler Idiqut came to pay court.
translations.idiomatic: Ala Qush, chieftain of the Qarluq tribe of the Western Regions, came over in submission; the Uighur ruler Idiqut came to pay court.

sentences.zh: 二月，帝自將南伐，敗金將定薛於野狐嶺，取大水濼、豐利等縣。

translations.literal: In the second month the Emperor personally led a southern campaign, defeated the Jin general Ding Xue at Yehu Ridge, and took Dashuibo, Fengli, and other counties.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month the Emperor personally led a southern campaign, defeated the Jin general Ding Xue at Yehu Ridge, and took Dashuibo, Fengli, and other counties.

sentences.zh: 金復築烏沙堡。

translations.literal: The Jin again built Wusha Fort.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin again built Wusha Fort.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，命遮別攻烏沙堡及烏月營，拔之。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn he ordered Jebe to attack Wusha Fort and the Wuyue camp and took them.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn he ordered Jebe to attack Wusha Fort and the Wuyue camp and took them.

sentences.zh: 八月，帝及金師戰於宣平之會河川，敗之。

translations.literal: In the eighth month the Emperor fought the Jin army at the Hui River in Xuanping and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month the Emperor fought the Jin army at the Hui River in Xuanping and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 九月，拔德興府，居庸關守將遁去。

translations.literal: In the ninth month he took Dexing Prefecture; the defending general of Juyong Pass fled.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month he took Dexing Prefecture; the defending general of Juyong Pass fled.

sentences.zh: 遮別遂入關，抵中都。

translations.literal: Jebe then entered the pass and reached the Central Capital.
translations.idiomatic: Jebe then entered the pass and reached the Central Capital.

sentences.zh: 冬月，襲金群牧監，驅其馬而還。

translations.literal: In the winter month he raided the Jin imperial horse pastures and drove off their horses on returning.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter month he raided the Jin imperial horse pastures and drove off their horses on returning.

sentences.zh: 耶律阿海降，入見帝於行在所。

translations.literal: Yelü Ahay surrendered and entered to see the Emperor at the mobile court.
translations.idiomatic: Yelü Ahay surrendered and entered to see the Emperor at the mobile court.

sentences.zh: 皇子朮赤、察合台、窩闊台分徇雲內、東勝、武、朔等州，下之。

translations.literal: The princes Jochi, Chagatai, and Ögedei separately carried out campaigns in Yunnei, Dongsheng, Wu, and Shuo — and other prefectures — and reduced them.
translations.idiomatic: The princes Jochi, Chagatai, and Ögedei separately carried out campaigns in Yunnei, Dongsheng, Wu, Shuo, and other prefectures and reduced them.

sentences.zh: 是冬，駐蹕金之北境。

translations.literal: That winter he halted the imperial progress on the northern border of the Jin.
translations.idiomatic: That winter he halted the imperial progress on the northern border of the Jin.

sentences.zh: 劉伯林、夾谷長哥等來降。
七年壬申春正月，耶律留哥聚眾於隆安，自為都元帥，遣使來附。
帝破昌、桓、撫等州。
金將紇石烈九斤等率兵三十萬來援，帝與戰於貛兒觜，大敗之。
秋，圍西京。
金元帥左都監奧屯襄率師來援，帝遣兵誘至密穀口，逆擊之，盡殪。
復攻西京，帝中流矢，遂撤圍。
九月，察罕克奉聖州。
冬十二月甲申，遮別攻東京不拔，即引去，夜馳還，襲克之。
八年癸酉春，耶律留哥自立為遼王，改元元統。
秋七月，克宣德府，遂攻德興府。
皇子拖雷、駙馬赤駒先登，拔之。
帝進至懷來，及金行省完顏綱、元帥高琪戰，敗之，追至北口。
金兵保居庸。
詔可忒、薄刹守之，遂趨涿鹿。
金西京留守忽沙虎遁去。
帝出紫荊關，敗金師於五回嶺，拔涿、易二州。
契丹訛魯不兒等獻北口，遮別遂取居庸，與可忒、薄刹會。
八月，金忽沙虎弑其主允濟，迎豐王珣立之。
是秋，分兵三道：命皇子朮赤、察合台、窩闊台為右軍，循太行而南，取保、遂、安肅、安、定、邢、洺、磁、相、衛、輝、懷、孟，掠澤、潞、遼、沁、平陽、太原、吉、隰，拔汾、石、嵐、忻、代、武等州而還；
皇弟哈撒兒及斡陳那顏、拙赤、薄刹為左軍，遵海而東，取薊州、平、灤、遼西諸郡而還；
帝與皇子拖雷為中軍，取雄、霸、莫、安、河間、滄、景、獻、深、祁、蠡、冀、恩、濮、開、滑、博、濟、泰安、濟南、濱、棣、益都、淄、濰、登、萊、沂等郡。
復命木華黎攻密州，屠之。
史天倪、蕭勃迭率眾來降，木華黎承制並以為萬戶。
帝至中都，三道兵還，合屯大口。
是歲，河北郡縣盡拔，唯中都、通、順、真定、清、沃、大名、東平、德、邳、海州十一城不下。
九年甲戌春三月，駐蹕中都北郊。
諸將請乘勝破燕，帝不從，乃遣使諭金主曰：「汝山東、河北郡縣悉為我有，汝所守惟燕京耳。
天既弱汝，我復迫汝於險，天其謂我何？
我今還軍，汝不能犒師以弭我諸將之怒耶？
」金主遂遣使求和，奉衛紹王女岐國公主及金帛、童男女五百、馬三千以獻，仍遣其丞相完顏福興送帝出居庸。
夏五月，金主遷汴，以完顏福興及參政抹撚盡忠輔其太子守忠，留守中都。
六月，金糺軍斫答等殺其主帥，率眾來降。
詔三摸合、石抹明安與斫答等圍中都。
帝避暑魚兒濼。
秋七月，金太子守忠走汴。
冬十月，木華黎征遼東，高州盧琮、金樸等降。
錦州張鯨殺其節度使，自立為臨海王，遣使來降。
十年乙亥春正月，金右副元帥蒲察七斤以通州降，以七斤為元帥。
二月，木華黎攻北京，金元帥寅答虎、烏古倫以城降，以寅答虎為留守，吾也而權兵馬都元帥鎮之。
興中府元帥石天應來降，以天應為興中府尹。
三月，金御史中丞李英等率師援中都，戰於霸州，敗之。
夏四月，克清、順二州。
詔張鯨總北京十提控兵從南征，鯨謀叛，伏誅。
鯨弟致遂據錦州，僭號漢興皇帝，改元興龍。
五月庚申，金中都留守完顏福興仰藥死，抹撚盡忠棄城走，明安入守之。
是月，避暑桓州涼涇，遣忽都忽等籍中都帑藏。
秋七月，紅羅山寨主杜秀降，以秀為錦州節度使。
遣乙職裏往諭金主以河北、山東未下諸城來獻，及去帝號為河南王，當為罷兵，不從。
詔史天倪南征，授右副都元帥，賜金虎符。
八月，天倪取平州，金經略使乞住降。
木華黎遣史進道等攻廣寧府，降之。
是秋，取城邑凡八百六十有二。
冬月，金宣撫蒲鮮萬奴據遼東，僭稱天王，國號大真，改元天泰。
十一月，耶律留哥來朝，以其子斜闍入侍。
史天祥討興州，擒其節度使趙守玉。
十一年丙子春，還廬朐河行宮。
張致陷興中府，木華黎討平之。
秋，撒裏知兀三摸合拔都魯率師由西夏趨關中，遂越潼關，獲金西安軍節度使尼龐古薄魯虎，拔汝州等郡，抵汴京而還。
冬十月，薄鮮萬奴降，以其子帖哥入侍。
既而復叛，僭稱東夏。
十二年丁丑夏，盜祁和尚據武平，史天祥討平之，遂擒金將巢元帥以獻。
察罕破金監軍夾谷於霸州，金求和，察罕乃還。
秋八月，以木華黎為太師，封國王，將蒙古、糺、漢諸軍南征，拔遂城、蠡州。
冬，克大名府，遂東定益都、淄、登、萊、濰、密等州。
是歲，禿滿部民叛，命缽魯完、朵魯伯討平之。
十三年戊寅秋八月，兵出紫荊口，獲金行元帥事張柔，命還其舊職。
木華黎自西京入河東，克太原、平陽及忻、代、澤、潞、汾、霍等州。
金將武仙攻滿城，張柔擊敗之。
是年，伐西夏，圍其王城，夏主李遵頊出走西涼。
契丹六哥據高麗江東城，命哈真、劄剌率師平之；
高麗王皞遂降，請歲貢方物。
十四年己卯春，張柔敗武仙，降祁陽、曲陽、中山等城。
夏六月，西域殺使者，帝率師親征，取訛答剌城，擒其酋哈只兒只蘭禿。
秋，木華黎克岢嵐、吉、隰等州，進攻絳州，拔其城，屠之。
十五年庚辰春三月，帝克蒲華城。
夏五月，克尋思幹城，駐蹕也兒的石河。
秋，攻斡脫羅兒城，克之。
木華黎徇地至真定，武仙出降。
以史天倪為河北西路兵馬都元帥、行府事，仙副之。
東平嚴實籍彰德、大名、磁、洺、恩、博、滑、浚等州戶三十萬來歸，木華黎承制授實金紫光祿大夫、行尚書省事。
冬，金邢州節度使武貴降。
木華黎攻東平，不克，留嚴實守之，撤圍趨洺州，分兵徇河北諸郡。
是歲，授董俊龍虎衛上將軍、右副都元帥。
十六年辛巳春，帝攻卜哈兒、薛迷思幹等城，皇子朮赤攻養吉幹、八兒真等城，並下之。
夏四月，駐蹕鐵門關，金主遣烏古孫仲端奉國書請和，稱帝為兄，不允。
金東平行省事忙古棄城遁，嚴實入守之。
宋遣苟夢玉來請和。
夏六月，宋漣水忠義統轄石珪率眾來降，以珪為濟、兗、單三州總管。
秋，帝攻班勒紇等城，皇子朮赤、察合台、窩闊台分攻玉龍傑赤等城，下之。
冬十月，皇子拖雷克馬魯察葉可、馬魯、昔剌思等城。
木華黎出河西，克葭、綏德、保安、鄜、坊、丹等州，進攻延安，不下。
十一月，宋京東安撫使張琳以京東諸郡來降，以琳為滄、景、濱、棣等州行都元帥。
是歲詔諭德順州。
十七年壬午春，皇子拖雷克徒思、匿察兀兒等城，還經木剌夷國，大掠之，渡搠搠闌河，克也裏等城。
遂與帝會，合兵攻塔里寒寨，拔之。
木華黎軍克乾、涇、邠、原等州，攻鳳翔，不下。
夏，避暑塔里寒寨。
西域主劄闌丁出奔，與滅裏可汗合，忽都忽與戰不利。
帝自將擊之，擒滅裏可汗。
劄闌丁遁去，遣八剌追之，不獲。
秋，金復遣烏古孫仲端來請和，見帝於回鶻國。
帝謂曰：「我向欲汝主授我河朔地，令汝主為河南王，彼此罷兵，汝主不從。
今木華黎已盡取之，乃始來請耶？
」仲端乞哀，帝曰：「念汝遠來，河朔既為我有，關西數城未下者，其割付我，令汝主為河南王，勿復違也。
」仲端乃歸。
金平陽公胡天祚以青龍堡降。
冬十月，金河中府來附，以石天應為兵馬都元帥守之。
十九年甲申夏，宋大名總管彭義斌侵河北，史天倪與戰於恩州，敗之。
是歲，帝至東印度國，角端見，班師。
二十年乙酉春正月，還行宮。
二月，武仙以真定叛，殺史天倪。
董俊判官李全亦以中山叛。
三月，史天澤擊仙走之，復真定。
夏六月，彭義斌以兵應仙，天澤禦於贊皇，擒斬之。
二十一年丙戌春正月，帝以西夏納仇人亦喝翔昆及不遣質子，自將伐之。
二月，取黑水等城。
夏，避暑於渾垂山。
取甘、肅等州。
秋，取西涼府搠羅、河羅等縣，遂逾沙陀，至黃河九渡，取應裏等縣。
九月，李全執張琳，郡王帶孫進兵圍全於益都。
冬十一月庚申，帝攻靈州，夏遣嵬名令公來援。
丙寅，帝渡河擊夏師，敗之。
丁丑，五星聚見於西南。
駐蹕鹽州川。
十二月，李全降。
授張柔行軍千戶、保州等處都元帥。
是歲，皇子窩闊台及察罕之師圍金南京，遣唐慶責歲幣於金。
二十二年丁亥春，帝留兵攻夏王城，自率師渡河攻積石州。
二月，破臨洮府。
三月，破洮、河、西寧二州。
遣斡陳那顏攻信都府，拔之。
夏四月，帝次龍德，拔德順等州，德順節度使愛申、進士馬肩龍死焉。
五月，遣唐慶等使金。
閏月，避暑六盤山。
六月，金遣完顏合周、奧屯阿虎來請和。
帝謂群臣曰：「朕自去冬五星聚時，已嘗許不殺掠，遽忘下詔耶。
今可佈告中外，令彼行人亦知朕意。
」是月，夏主李晛降。
帝次清水縣西江。
秋七月壬午，不豫。
己丑，崩於薩里川哈老徒之行宮。
臨崩謂左右曰：「金精兵在潼關，南據連山，北限大河，難以遽破。
若假道於宋，宋、金世仇，必能許我，則下兵唐、鄧，直搗大梁。
金急，必徵兵潼關。
然以數萬之眾，千里赴援，人馬疲弊，雖至弗能戰，破之必矣。
」言訖而崩，壽六十六，葬起輦穀。
至元三年冬十月，追諡聖武皇帝。
至大二年冬十一月庚辰，加諡法天啟運聖武皇帝，廟號太祖。
在位二十二年。
帝深沉有大略，用兵如神，故能滅國四十，遂平西夏。
其奇勳偉跡甚眾，惜乎當時史官不備，或多失於紀載云。
戊子年。
是歲，皇子拖雷監國。
